name: Yuyu
description: A star 102 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.

radius.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 43103: radius 21.353 solar radii, implied by the fitted luminosity 256.838 solar luminosities (fractional uncertainty 0.08) and temperature

temperature.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 43103: effective temperature 5004 +/- 125 K, from the fit of a model atmosphere to the star's spectral energy distribution (goodness of fit Q 0.052)

gravity.source: SIMBAD's compilation of spectroscopic measurements (mesFe_h): log g 2.4 from 2014AJ....147..137L; the 14 published values span log g 1.8 to 2.69, across which the limb law changes by at most 0.3% of the centre brightness

distance.source: McDonald, Zijlstra & Watson (2017), MNRAS 471, 770, table 2, HIP 43103: distance 101.523 pc, the paper's parallax inverted (Gaia DR1's where it revised the star's, else the Hipparcos reduction of van Leeuwen 2007; section 2.3; fractional uncertainty 0.062), at which the luminosity and radius hold

text.card: A star 102 parsecs away, 21 times the Sun's width, measured from its light.
text.introduction: Its brightness, measured band by band, gives 257 times the Sun's luminosity at 5,004 K, so 21.353 solar radii.
text.locator: Table 2, HIP 43103: D, Teff, L, Rad, Q

quotes.title: Iota Cancri
quotes.card: Iota Cancri, also named Yuyu, is a double star in the constellation Cancer.
quotes.introduction: The brighter component is located at a distance of approximately 347 light-years (106 pc) from Earth based on parallax measurements, and is drifting further away with a line of sight velocity of 16 km/s.
